settings.locked_by_env: Set by an environment variable to {value} — change it there, not here.
settings.locked_by_code: Set in code (config.php or extend.php) to {value} — change it there, not here.
settings.mail_help:
Control how many emails are sent at the same time. Each worker sends one
email at a time, so this is the number of simultaneous outgoing messages.
Set it to your mail provider's concurrent-connection limit so you don't
exceed it. Leave blank for the default (1).
settings.email_concurrency_help:
The maximum number of emails delivered at once. An environment variable
(REDIS_HORIZON_EMAIL_CONCURRENCY) or config.php value, if set, overrides
this.
settings.trim_help:
Here you can configure for how long (in minutes) you desire Horizon to
persist the recent and failed jobs. Typically, recent jobs are kept
for one hour while all failed jobs are stored for an entire week.
settings.trim_recent_help: This table is used to display recent jobs in the Horizon dashboard.
settings.trim_pending_help: This table is used to display pending jobs in the Horizon dashboard.
settings.trim_completed_help: This table is used to display completed jobs in the Horizon dashboard.
settings.trim_recent_failed_help: This table is used to display recent failed jobs in the Horizon dashboard.
settings.trim_failed_help: This table is used to display failed jobs in the Horizon dashboard.
settings.trim_monitored_help: This table is used to display monitored jobs in the Horizon dashboard.
settings.supervisor_help:
Horizon runs your queue workers in tiered profiles (standard, fast,
long, emails). Worker counts, memory and queues are configured per
deployment via REDIS_HORIZON_* environment variables, config.php (under
the "horizon" key), or the Horizon extender in extend.php — see the
extension's README. Restart Horizon after changing worker configuration.
settings.memory_limit_help:
Memory limit for the Horizon master supervisor process: past it, the
master restarts itself. Each worker's memory is set by its supervisor.
